notes: Only assigned unfinished fields inspected for completion; all other values are unassigned placeholders. Canonical title and authors match Van Lange et al. (1997). No PDF supplied. The planned contrast is positively identified as prosocials versus individualists and competitors (F(1, 444) = 11.09). However, the source prints orientation classification counts before missing-value exclusions and N = 453 for a separate gender association, not an explicit final analytic N for the attachment contrast. The three discarded participants are not allocated to final groups; missing-gender overlap is not documented. No final-group sum or df inference used.
